card.name: Just before a number in history stories
card.fires_on: Words and spaces right before an expected number or time span in narrative history, myth or trivia text. It fires on the slot where a count, amount or duration is about to appear.

modes.label: Before a count or amount
modes.description: The marked spot sits just before a number such as a year, a quantity or a sum.

modes.label: Before a duration
modes.description: The marked word comes just before a length of time such as nine nights.
modes.example: Zeus was united with Mnemosyne<< for>> nine consecutive nights on the mountain of Pier

modes.label: Spelled-out numbers
modes.description: The marked word is itself a spelled-out number in a story about past events.
modes.example: to scourge<< thirty>>-four women at church

card.writes: It promotes time-span and number words, mostly Chinese ones like 'each day' and 'three days', and suppresses hedges like 'probably'.
card.plain: It lights up where a story is about to give a number or a length of time.
